decisions.title: Exact beta capability and payload selection
decisions.recommendation: Approve the proposed independently versioned core/SDK component closure and explicit optional payloads. Preserve every retained promise until an explicit disposition is recorded.

decisions.title: Core and Cloudflare platform applicability
decisions.recommendation: Retain all four core profiles. Treat Cloudflare vendor runtime as a separately qualified Intel macOS closure; select its exact OS/profile. Other vendor artifact targets remain unadmitted; resolve any all-platform promise explicitly.

decisions.title: Retained promises needing missing implementation
decisions.recommendation: Keep general L14/OS providers/native consumers, TWS bridge, CF rotation/project execution and any missing risk/state composition visible as blocked promises. Freeze remains; choose an explicit scope disposition or narrowly approved exception before new capability work.

decisions.title: Publisher trust and actual payload review
decisions.recommendation: Select independently obtained trust roots, custody/recovery, native OS trust expectations and payload reviewer. Actual bytes, loader/TLS closure and source/notices remain review requirements.

decisions.title: Named engineering and operational ownership
decisions.recommendation: Assign the currently null roles and per-component/profile coverage; preserve @quantDIY as release/rollback primary. Proposed roles and agents are not personnel assignments.

decisions.title: Delivery channels and separate MCP dependency
decisions.recommendation: Propose verified direct candidate downloads first; select any MCPB/registry/OpenAI directory or other distribution explicitly. Version/catalogue/client acceptance and external approvals remain separate.

decisions.title: Paper criteria applicability and score policy
decisions.recommendation: Review all58 proposed criteria alongside the36 existing core cells. Preserve user-led live qualification after packaging. Adopt any score threshold and simulator substitution only explicitly; no current score/date is inferred.

evidence_policy: No credentials, private keys, licensed SDK bytes or private provider payloads in Git. Public dossier retains nonsecret identities and redacted evidence pointers only.
